message.content:
Dasatinib tablets in measured doses for retail sale fall under heading 3004. Dasatinib is a thiazole-containing compound (it has a 2-aminothiazole ring), and it also contains a pyrimidine ring. Subheading 3004.90 covers "other" medicaments, and the 10-digit statistical suffix is the part I am recalling rather than certain of. CBP rulings for dasatinib (e.g., NY N0xx) classify it in 3004.90.9250, which is "Other: antineoplastic and immunosuppressive drugs, other." I believe the suffix 3004.90.9250 is correct, though I am less sure of it than of the heading.

{"hts_code": "3004.90.9250", "reason": "Dasatinib tablets are medicaments of heading 3004 put up in measured doses for retail sale, and as an antineoplastic drug they fall under the 'other' antineoplastic provision of subheading 3004.90."}
